description: Live E2E for the YOUR_DISPLAY_NAME RQL module. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py (scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module turns the suite red.
notes: rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its source is listed). The 'tools' then run every YOUR_FEATUREGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise). 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON (rows 'a|b|c', objects 'Class#id(name)'); 'expectFailure' inverts a call (it must fail with those substrings). When the module works on scene nodes, add a 'setup' call that opens a scene first: {"tool": "rql-mutate", "input": {"query": "editor | call NewScene(\"res://e2e_YOUR_TOOL_PREFIX.tscn\", \"Node3D\", \"Root\")"}, "expect": ["NewScene"]}.
